REST API¶

The REST API module provides endpoints for articles, newsletters, publishers, users, subscriptions, and approved article records.

REST API views for articles, newsletters, publishers, and users.

This module also handles editor approval, subscriber email notifications, and approved article logging. Define REST API views and supporting functions.
